  "memo_markdown": "Merchant 49 breached the chargeback-rate trigger as of June 19: three disputes across 88 trailing-30-day orders, or 3.41%. Request campaign details to assess a benign explanation.\n\nRepeated non-delivery, corroborated thin-account concentration, and settlement extraction would strengthen the bust-out hypothesis and support reserve or a reversible settlement pause. Verified delivery, resolved disputes, or a corrected denominator would weaken the alert. Check the next window for persistence. Offboarding requires corroborated bust-out evidence; a human owns the action."
